# Buy Silent Disco Headsets

> Bali's largest silent disco brand. 600+ headphones powering events across 11 countries. Founded by Nic Huzz.

## What We Sell

- **Silent Disco Headphones**: $39 USD per unit. Hi-Fi sound, active noise cancellation, 3-channel LED system (Red/Green/Blue), 10+ hours battery, 500m RF wireless range, foldable, 1-year warranty.
- **Wireless Transmitters**: $169 USD per unit. Broadcasts to 500+ headphones simultaneously, 500m range, AUX/RCA/XLR inputs, works with any audio source.
- **Packages**: Starter (6 headphones + 1 transmitter) $403, Professional (20 + 1) $1,149, Enterprise (50 + 3) $2,957.

## Who We Are

Nic Huzz is the founder. Based in Bali, Indonesia. 200+ events hosted since 2022 across Australia, Bali, Thailand, Sri Lanka, India, Poland, Germany, Spain, USA, Japan, and Vietnam. Clients include Amazon, IBM, Google, and Sundays Beach Club Bali. 400+ hours breathwork certification from Samma Karuna, Koh Phangan, Thailand.

## Quick Facts

- Equipment uses RF (radio frequency), not Bluetooth — zero latency, zero dropouts, 500m range
- 0% equipment failure rate across 200+ events
- 90% of events use a single channel
- Equipment lifespan: 5+ years / 500+ events with proper care
- Break-even vs renting: approximately 7 events for a 20-headphone setup
- Ships worldwide from Bali, Indonesia
